query:
SELECT
            ug.user_id,
            u.username,
            u.email,
            ug.group_id,
            g.name as group_name
        FROM user_groups ug
        JOIN users u ON u.id = ug.user_id
        JOIN groups g ON g.id = ug.group_id
        WHERE ug.tenant_id = $1
          AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND g.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY u.username, g.name
        LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
